solution.title: Microsoft 365 → Google Workspace Migration Program & Wave Plan (Enterprise/150k+)

products.name: Microsoft 365 → Google Workspace Migration Program & Wave Plan (Enterprise/150k+) — Commercial
products.short_description: The end-to-end M365 → Google Workspace migration program for 150k+ users — discovery, wave planning, tooling strategy, coexistence, cutover runbooks, and hypercare — executed pilot-first so waves run without rework. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Move 150k users off Microsoft 365 without breaking the business

Migrating 150k+ users from Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace is a program, not a project — and it fails without a disciplined wave plan, coexistence design, and cutover governance. This flagship solution provides the end-to-end migration program: discovery, wave planning, tooling strategy, coexistence, cutover runbooks, and hypercare across mail, Drive, and collaboration — executed pilot-first so waves run without architectural rework.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Program Overview — the migration operating model (discovery → design → coexistence → waves → cutover → hypercare) and how the workstreams sequence.
  • Wave Planning & Tooling Strategy — how to segment 150k users into waves, choose and govern migration tooling/patterns (mail, Drive, Chat), and define coexistence during the transition.
  • Cutover Runbooks — per-wave runbooks (readiness, mail-flow/DNS, data move, validation, rollback) and the go/no-go gates for each wave.
  • 5 supporting scripts — source-estate discovery (M365/Entra), per-wave readiness validation, a migration-progress/coverage report, safe remediation, and a wave target-group builder.
  • Governance hooks + a Migration-Program playbook and Best Practices for executing waves without rework, plus Testing/validation gates.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

150k+ users moved to Google Workspace wave by wave — coexistence managed, cutovers governed, waves executed without architectural rework — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GWMIGPROG-Discovery.ps1 — baseline the Microsoft 365 source estate for migration wave planning
    • GWMIGPROG-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation of wave-readiness data gaps in a wave members list
    • GWMIGPROG-Report.ps1 — render migration-program progress and per-wave coverage
    • GWMIGPROG-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build a migration wave's target group in Microsoft Entra
    • GWMIGPROG-Validation.ps1 — confirm per-wave readiness before a migration cutover

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
